== Chapter One: Introduction

This document tests parsing and rendering of a large AsciiDoc file with many features.

=== Background

The parser must handle documents with hundreds of lines efficiently.
This paragraph contains *bold*, _italic_, `monospace`, and *_combined_* formatting.

=== Goals

. Parse correctly
. Render identical output across TFMs
. Handle edge cases gracefully
